description: Cold start, 3300 PAL frames (66 s), controller 1 only: the accepted 1P, MIKE and CRAWLER prefix; Down 1000-1005 moves the PICK TRACK highlight from DRAGSTER to ZOOM ZOO and is released before Start 1050-1055; Start 1200-1205 selects Race from NOW PLAYING, which displays MIKE vs BRONSEN and OVER 3 LAPS ON ZOOM ZOO. Right is held 1652-3299 after the observed timer start at 1583; Up remains held 2200-2259. Controller 2 is silent. Equivalent to tests/manifests/reference/race-crawler-zoom-zoo-right-1652-3300.json.
tested_behavior: Reference discovery only: two fresh cold-start processes have exact whole-WRAM/register and aggregate A/V identity through 3300 frames. The first race update is observed at frame 1377 after the NMI-off load at 1208-1376; the timer advances from frame 1583, leaving 1717 active timer frames. Right is deliberately delayed to frame 1652 for the M4-05 preregistered variation. Meanings outside the M4-02 inventory remain provisional.

inputs.injection_point: Buttons are presented on the libretro input callback before retro_run of the frame numbered `from`..`to` (0-based frames after power-on) and withdrawn before the following frame; the core polls the controllers once per frame (R-0002 finding 6). Sub-frame timing is not available.

fields.name: wram_sha256
fields.description: SHA-256 of the 131072-byte work RAM ($7E0000-$7FFFFF) at the end of the frame

fields.name: registers
fields.description: CPU register block at the end of the frame: pc, a, x, y, s, d, b, p, e, mdr, vcounter, hcounter, field, wai, stp

fields.name: wram_0000_0200
fields.description: Raw diagnostic range $7E0000-$7E01FF (direct page and the top of the stack area). No gameplay interpretation; M1 defines fields.
